threads.body: [Style] Per the repository Java style rules, classes under `javaagent/src/main/` should not be declared `final`. This newly added helper class uses `public final class`, which is inconsistent with the new `HbaseSingletons` classes added in this same PR (declared as `public class`). Consider dropping `final` here for consistency.
